traceability.notes: The valid-req-reference rule implements deep validation by reading referenced story files, extracting REQ-* identifiers, caching them, and verifying each @req and @implements requirement ID against that content. It rejects unsafe paths, reports clear and specific errors, integrates with the plugin’s dynamic rule loading and severity mapping, and is covered by focused tests and dedicated documentation. All acceptance criteria for story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION are satisfied, so the story is considered fully implemented.
